ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for approximately <5% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-frequency, low-diameter white pixel clusters (mottling) scattered stochastically across the left and right lobes; no contiguous macro-level geometric bands detected.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 95-degree interior angle and a depth of approximately 12% of the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks varies between 3 and 8 pixels relative to the local baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (diameters 5-15 pixels) concentrated in the mid-region of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible, primarily on the right lobe, oriented at a roughly 45-degree angle to the notch axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy accumulation of irregular, high-contrast calcified masses (barnacles) on the distal tips of both lobes, particularly the left tip (viewer perspective), creating significant geometric irregularity.
other_distinctive_markers: Protruding textured clusters at the fluke tips that extend beyond the primary dermal trailing edge boundary.
